assessment_or_required_action: Included ledgers have complete outcome and prediction fields and use no imputation; ineligible or unresolved records are excluded by frozen upstream rules.

assessment_or_required_action: Exact-Kd eligibility, recognized units, identity resolution, and prohibited post-error deletion are recorded.

REFORMS_requirement: Describe handling of impossible or corrupt samples
assessment_or_required_action: Risk flags and prediction-blind review queues exist, but zero independent human adjudications are signed.

REFORMS_requirement: Describe transformations from raw data to model-ready data
assessment_or_required_action: pKd conversion, standardization, scaffold and protein grouping, feature construction, aggregation, and fallback rules are documented.

package_location: Methods: Model specifications and claim boundary; Table S1
assessment_or_required_action: All six specifications including the constant reference, dimensions, objectives, and analytic roles are listed.

REFORMS_requirement: Justify model-type choices
assessment_or_required_action: The panel probes ligand-only, protein-only, additive, interaction, and qualifier-aware representations while retaining a simple reference.

REFORMS_requirement: Describe model evaluation, splits, or cross-validation
assessment_or_required_action: Development fitting, frozen external transfer, cold strata, cluster bootstrap, and post-unblinding roles are separated.

REFORMS_requirement: Describe selection of reported models
assessment_or_required_action: All fixed nonreference specifications are retained; models are not omitted according to external performance.

REFORMS_requirement: Report tuning ranges, selection method, and final hyperparameters
assessment_or_required_action: HGB fixed parameters and AFT objective, regularization, subsampling, and frozen iteration are reported with tuning scope.

REFORMS_requirement: Justify comparison against appropriate baselines
package_location: Methods: Performance estimands; Development-only entity priors; Fig. 4C
assessment_or_required_action: A frozen constant and entity priors are included; a locked matched-series or nearest-neighbor baseline is still required for prospective medicinal-chemistry utility.

REFORMS_requirement: Show that preprocessing and modeling use training information only
package_location: Methods: Study design and outcome-access chronology; Table S6
assessment_or_required_action: External outcomes were blocked for frozen prediction cycles; all later outcome-aware analyses are labeled retrospective.

REFORMS_requirement: Address dependencies or duplicates between training and test data
assessment_or_required_action: Exact-pair overlap is zero; scaffold, protein identity, ligand, and connected-document dependence are measured and included in inference.

REFORMS_requirement: Justify that each feature is legitimate and does not leak the outcome
assessment_or_required_action: Feature provenance is documented and identity nulls are complete, but source-target-family confounding and intended-feature specificity remain unresolved.

REFORMS_requirement: Report and justify all performance metrics
assessment_or_required_action: Rank, point accuracy, calibration, dispersion, coverage, conditional coverage, and null contrasts are reported; delta MAE is not mislabeled as decision utility.

REFORMS_requirement: Report uncertainty estimates and calculation methods
package_location: Methods: Rank inference and multiplicity; Tables S2-S4
assessment_or_required_action: Component bootstrap, max-t intervals, multiway-cluster covariance, dependence envelopes, and finite-null uncertainty are specified.

REFORMS_requirement: Justify statistical tests and check assumptions
assessment_or_required_action: Rank regression, clustered dependence, paired permutations, multiplicity, and descriptive covariance limits are stated; sensitivity schemes avoid row-independence assumptions.

REFORMS_requirement: Describe evidence of external validity
assessment_or_required_action: Two external sources support a reproducible source-wide rank association, but all v1.7 decomposition analyses are retrospective and no future temporal source has been executed.

REFORMS_requirement: Describe contexts in which findings are not expected to hold
assessment_or_required_action: The manuscript excludes mechanism, therapeutic efficacy, calibrated deployment, unseen-target superiority, and general architecture claims.
